info.name: LearningHub — API Quality & Regression Suite (Django DRF)
info.description: Canonical Django REST Framework API regression collection. Source references: README.md, API_CONTRACT.md and BACKEND_TRUTH.md. Configure baseUrl for the target environment. Smoke folders are GET-only; authentication flow requests are manual/local and require a dedicated non-production account.

exec: pm.test('Response time below smoke threshold (5s)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(5000); });
pm.test('Response body is valid JSON when present', function () { if (pm.response.text().length > 0) pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test('Health endpoint returns a healthy status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 204]); });
pm.test('Health check completes within 2 seconds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(2000); });
pm.test('Login returns 200 or 201', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]); });
const body = pm.response.json();
const access = body?.data?.tokens?.access || body?.tokens?.access || body?.data?.access || body?.access;
const refresh = body?.data?.tokens?.refresh || body?.tokens?.refresh || body?.data?.refresh || body?.refresh;
pm.test('Login response contains an access token', function () { pm.expect(access, 'access token').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('Login response contains a refresh token', function () { pm.expect(refresh, 'refresh token').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
if (access) pm.environment.set('accessToken', access);
if (refresh) pm.environment.set('refreshToken', refresh);
pm.test('Refresh returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
const access = body?.data?.tokens?.access || body?.tokens?.access || body?.data?.access || body?.access;
const refresh = body?.data?.tokens?.refresh || body?.tokens?.refresh || body?.data?.refresh || body?.refresh;
pm.test('Refresh response contains a new access token', function () { pm.expect(access, 'access token').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
if (access) pm.environment.set('accessToken', access);
if (refresh) pm.environment.set('refreshToken', refresh);
pm.test('Current-user endpoint requires a valid token', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Current-user response is a JSON object', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Course catalog is available', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Course catalog returns a JSON object', function () { pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Course catalog follows the documented response envelope', function () { pm.expect(body).to.have.property('status'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('data'); });
pm.test('Test catalog is publicly accessible', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Test catalog returns a JSON object', function () { pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Test catalog follows the documented response envelope', function () { pm.expect(body).to.have.property('status'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('data'); });

item.name: Current User — reject anonymous access
item.description: Negative security check: the profile endpoint must reject requests without a JWT. Expected 401 or 403 per DRF authentication/permission behavior.

exec: pm.test('Anonymous profile request is rejected', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401, 403]); });
pm.test('Anonymous request does not expose a profile', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).not.to.equal(200); });
